name: Connected Australia
summary: Toowoomba/Queensland telco/ISP (CONNECTED AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 169 830 451; brands Connected Australia, Lemonade Broadband, later Pivit); reportedly acquired by On Q Communications ~Dec 2023, entity still active.

events.details: Operating company CONNECTED AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (ABN 90 169 830 451, ACN 169 830 451) registered 29 May 2014; 'Connected Australia' business name from 23 May 2018. Reportedly founded 2015.

Reportedly acquired by On Q Communications c.2023; the operating entity CONNECTED AUSTRALIA PTY LTD remains active on ABR and has since added business names LEMONADE BROADBAND (2 May 2024) and Pivit (25 Oct 2025).

ACN misattribution corrected: an earlier version cited CONNECTED GROUP AUSTRALIA PTY LIMITED (ABN 72 112 124 231, ACN 112 124 231). That entity trades as 'Connected Switchgear'/'Connected Cable' (electrical products) and is an unrelated name collision; the telco/ISP's actual entity is CONNECTED AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (ACN 169 830 451), which holds the 'Connected Australia' and 'Lemonade Broadband' business names.
